LanguageData.SaveOptions_NegativeEventsTip: Save to "Bad Event" when a negative event or major threat letter arrives. Saves run between ticks and wait while saving is temporarily disabled.
LanguageData.SaveOptions_AppendEventLabel: Add the event name to the save filename
LanguageData.SaveOptions_AppendEventLabelTip: Requires Save on negative events. Use a separate filename for each event label instead of overwriting "Bad Event".
LanguageData.SaveOptions_NegativeEventsRequired: Requires Save on negative events. Measured in real time.
LanguageData.SaveOptions_SaveAndQuitTip: Replace the normal quit buttons with Save and Quit, using your colony's name. Hold Alt to quit without saving. Commitment mode keeps its normal buttons.
LanguageData.SaveOptions_SaveOnGameStartTip: Save after the intro is dismissed and the starting drop pods have landed. Each new colony overwrites the same "Start" file.
LanguageData.SaveOptions_AutoLoad: Automatically load the latest save on startup
LanguageData.SaveOptions_AutoLoadTip: Load the most recently modified save, including autosaves. Returning to the menu does not reload it. Startup errors or a previous failed automatic load keep you at the menu.
LanguageData.SaveOptions_ShowPrompt: Show a countdown before automatically loading
LanguageData.SaveOptions_ShowPromptTip: Requires automatic loading. Press any key or click during the countdown to stay at the main menu.
LanguageData.SaveOptions_PromptRequired: Requires automatic loading and the startup countdown.
LanguageData.SaveOptions_LoggingTip: Requires automatic loading. Write the automatically loaded save's name to the game log. Errors are always logged.
LanguageData.SaveOptions_AutoLoadPrompt: Loading your latest save in {0} seconds.\nPress any key or click to stay at the main menu.
LanguageData.SaveOptions_SaveFailed: Could not save "{0}". Your colony remains open.
